serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The Slack API server endpoint URL.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The Slack channel to receive messages from.

token.title: Token
token.description: The Bot User OAuth Access Token to access Slack. A Slack app that has the following permissions is required: `channels:history`, `groups:history`, `im:history`, `mpim:history`, `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, and `mpim:read`.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The delay between polls. If no unit provided, milliseconds is the default.

naturalOrder.title: Natural Order
naturalOrder.description: Create exchanges in natural order (oldest to newest) or not.
